responding_to.type: bus trapped by floodwater with passengers
man trapped in car by floodwater

output.english: There is dangerous flooding in Shockoe Bottom and South Junction. Avoid Dock St and Lee Bridge because they are closed. Do not drive through floodwater and call for help if you are in danger.
output.spanish: Hay inundaciones peligrosas en Shockoe Bottom y South Junction. Evite Dock St y Lee Bridge porque están cerradas. No conduzca por el agua y pida ayuda si está en peligro.
